name: Three-Trade Crew
description: Park three specialist workers in their matching workshop exit bays while gates and cargo change the reachable floor. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs.
natural_language: Park all three workers in the matching exit bays. Read the lane walls, hold the yellow gate and then the purple gate while the crew crosses, and preserve the correct selected worker before certifying. The fighter pushes crates, the thief pulls crates as it walks, and the wizard swaps places with a crate. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.source_notes: The source record's fighter push, thief pull, wizard block exchange, active-worker switching, held switches, doors, and mutual Hero/Goal win predicates are transformed into an original cutaway workshop with generated geometry, original browser art, and independent replay grading.
metadata.notes: The baseline is the hard L4 full-keyboard condition. Browser-visible geometry and the independent grader replay the same worker, crate, switch, gate, and exit-bay transitions. Scripted solutions are implementation evidence, not screenshot-only agent evidence.
